title: Clutch.co Scraper input
description: Scrape Clutch.co category and directory listing pages into structured company lead records.

categoryUrl.title: Single Clutch category URL
categoryUrl.description: Use this when you have one Clutch.co category, service, or directory URL to scrape, such as https://clutch.co/it-services, /web-developers, or /agencies/digital-marketing. If searchUrls is set, searchUrls wins. This actor scrapes listing pages, not individual /profile/ review pages.
categoryUrl.sectionDescription: Paste one or more public Clutch.co listing pages. The default run uses the IT services directory.

searchUrls.title: Multiple Clutch listing URLs
searchUrls.description: Use this when you want to scrape several Clutch.co listing pages in one run. Each item should be a category, service, search, or location directory URL that shows company cards. Example: https://clutch.co/web-developers. Do not pass individual company profile URLs here.

startUrls.title: Advanced start URLs
startUrls.description: Use this when calling from Apify integrations that provide request-list objects. Accepts Clutch.co listing URLs as strings or objects with a url field. Kept for backwards compatibility with older clutch-scraper integrations.

location.title: Clutch geolocation filter
location.description: Use this when you want Clutch to narrow the directory server-side with the geolocation query parameter. Examples: United States, London, India. Leave empty for global listings.
location.sectionDescription: Filters are applied after loading listing cards, except geolocation, which is added to the Clutch URL.

minRating.title: Minimum star rating
minRating.description: Use this when you only want companies with a Clutch star rating at or above the chosen value. Decimals are allowed, for example 4.5. Companies with no rating are dropped when this is set.

minReviews.title: Minimum review count
minReviews.description: Use this when you only want companies with at least this many Clutch reviews. Companies with no visible review count are dropped when this is set.

verifiedOnly.title: Verified companies only
verifiedOnly.description: Use this when you want only companies that show a Clutch verified badge. Defaults to false.

excludeSponsored.title: Exclude sponsored listings
excludeSponsored.description: Use this when you want to drop paid or featured placements and keep only organic listing cards. Defaults to false.

serviceKeyword.title: Service keyword
serviceKeyword.description: Use this when you want a case-insensitive filter against each company's displayed services. Example: mobile app, SEO, software. Leave empty to keep all services.

locationKeyword.title: Location keyword
locationKeyword.description: Use this when you want a case-insensitive filter against each company's displayed location text. Example: New York or India. Leave empty to keep all locations.

maxResults.title: Max companies
maxResults.description: Maximum company records to return and bill for. Pagination stops once this limit is reached. Bounds: 1 to 5000.

maxPages.title: Max pages per URL
maxPages.description: Safety cap on listing pagination per start URL. Increase it for very large categories or restrictive filters. Defaults automatically from maxResults.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of parallel browser pages. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
